entry.title: Sysex Bandit 1.0.1
entry.summary: # Sysex Bandit 1.0.1 A VST2 "instrument" for MPC OS that sends and receives MIDI System Exclusive: pick or hand-edit a `.syx` message, aim `OUT PORT` at the device you want, press SEND, listen on one input and save what arrives. It makes no sound — the real I/O is a pair of ALSA sequencer ports the plugin opens itself. ## What's new in 1.0.1 - **SEND page pacing** (`SPEED`: `DELAY` / `BUF` / `GAP`) — a big dump goes out in blocks with gaps, so a bank lands whole instead of overrunning the synth'
